---
title: "Package Installation"
author: "López-Chablé Edgard Uriel"
output: html_document
---

Run this file once before the numbered analysis scripts. The analysis was
developed under R 4.5.2 / Bioconductor 3.22; the exact package versions used
are recorded in the `sessionInfo()` block at the end of every knitted report.

```{r cran, eval = FALSE}
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "rmarkdown", "knitr", "tinytex",
  "tidyverse", "viridis", "pheatmap", "cowplot", "ggrepel",
  "igraph", "ggraph", "tidygraph",
  "UpSetR", "plotly", "networkD3", "htmlwidgets", "webshot",
  "magick", "pdftools"
)
install.packages(setdiff(cran_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))

# LaTeX distribution for knitting to PDF, and PhantomJS for the Sankey export
tinytex::install_tinytex()
webshot::install_phantomjs()
```

```{r bioconductor, eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "tximport", "DESeq2", "sva", "EnhancedVolcano",
  "clusterProfiler", "enrichplot", "GO.db", "pathview",
  "KEGGREST", "STRINGdb"
)
BiocManager::install(setdiff(bioc_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))
```

```{r check}
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "viridis", "pheatmap", "cowplot", "ggrepel",
          "igraph", "ggraph", "tidygraph", "UpSetR", "plotly", "networkD3",
          "htmlwidgets", "webshot", "magick", "pdftools",
          "tximport", "DESeq2", "sva", "EnhancedVolcano",
          "clusterProfiler", "enrichplot", "GO.db", "pathview",
          "KEGGREST", "STRINGdb")
missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
data.frame(package = pkgs,
           version = vapply(pkgs, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), character(1)),
           row.names = NULL)
```
